Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Snorkel Finance Reasoning · human annotation: Snorkel describes co-creating the Finance Reasoning question-answer pairs with its financial-expert network for questions requiring reasoning and SQL tool use over relational tables converted from company 10-K filings.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.snorkel-finance.construction.v2

  • This is the creator’s explicit co-creation account; it does not establish recruitment, pay, per-question annotator counts or an independent accuracy audit.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Snorkel Finance Reasoning · evaluates: Snorkel’s Finance Reasoning method uses Claude 3.7 Sonnet as an LLM judge supplied with a reference answer to assess final-answer correctness and completeness.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.snorkel-finance.judgment.v2

  • The judge configuration is creator-described; judge decisions were not independently reproduced or equated with human adjudication.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Snorkel Finance Reasoning · has stage: The captured Finance Reasoning methodology describes an evaluation cap of 15 minutes or 100 turns and includes traces ending in API errors, recursion limits or premature termination when reporting accuracy.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.snorkel-finance.runtime-scope.v2

  • This limit belongs to the captured methodology version, not every historical or future trace release.
  • Including failed traces describes the reported evaluation denominator; it is not evidence that every released trace completed successfully.
